summary: Post-market close: the composite risk score rose to 47.98 from 45.23, with the macro dimension at 63.8 the only binding constraint - the 10-year Treasury yield at 4.96 percent is the highest since 2007 and the 10-year real rate at 2.6 percent sits at the 100th percentile. Beneath a calm index headline the structure deteriorated clearly: none of the 155 names printed a new high, 10.97 percent printed new lows, and semis lagged by 21.02 percentage points. Volatility repriced as VIX rose to 17.1 from 15.84 and high-yield spreads widened to 2.71 percent. Only 7 of 22 sectors and themes advanced, led by networking at 1.39 percent and cybersecurity at 0.94 percent, while the speculative tail - fintech at -1.98 percent and the EV supply chain at -2.06 percent - led the decline; crypto weakened in tandem, with ether at 2403.49.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The 10-year real rate rose to 2.6 percent at the 100th percentile, contributing 5.00 weighted risk points to the macro dimension - the heaviest single macro constraint today.
The 10-year Treasury yield printed 4.96 percent at the 99.92nd percentile, the highest since 2007, keeping long-end rates a persistent drag on duration-sensitive valuations.
Breadth turned negative: none of the 155 names printed a new high, 10.97 percent printed new lows, and only 52.26 percent sat above the 200-day average.
Volatility and credit weakened together: VIX rose to 17.1 from 15.84 and high-yield spreads widened to 2.71 percent from 2.65 percent.
Cross-asset confirmation rose to 0.625 with 6 of 10 signals triggered, spanning dollar strength, real-rate pressure and a crypto drawdown.

supporting_signals.claim: Semis underperformed by 21.02 percentage points and small caps by 3.59 percentage points, concentrating risk appetite in large caps and leaving little basis for a breadth repair.
Crypto weakened in tandem: bitcoin at 75901, ether at 2403.49 and SOL at 97.7, confirming a contraction in the risk-appetite tail.
Policy expectations are tight: the swaps-implied policy rate of 4.105 percent sits against an effective fed funds rate of 3.63 percent, and the model classifies the direction as a hike.

Leadership inside AI hardware split: AMD +2.16 percent and NVIDIA +0.52 percent advanced while Broadcom fell -1.47 percent, yet memory at -1.11 percent, semiconductor equipment at -1.11 percent and data centers at -1.20 percent weakened - buying stayed selective at the single-name level.

contradicting_signals.claim: The risk model still classifies the regime as goldilocks, realized volatility is only 8.8596 percent, and price sits 5.8419 percent above the 200-day average - the trend dimension has not broken down.
Inflation internals improved: core CPI eased to 2.44616 percent from 2.46652 percent, and the 5-year breakeven at 2.34 percent remains anchored.
Labor data stayed firm: payrolls added 162 thousand against 21 thousand previously, unemployment held at 4.1 percent, and initial claims of 206000 remained low.
Credit markets have not confirmed stress: investment-grade spreads held at 0.8 percent and high-yield spreads at 2.71 percent remain in a historically low range.

what_changed_today: The composite risk score rose to 47.98 from 45.23 with a one-day trend reading of 2.82, the largest single-day increase of the recent period, forcing a passive contraction in risk budget.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.96 percent from 4.95 percent (highest since 2007) and the 2-year moved to 4.63 percent from 4.56 percent, shifting the whole curve higher.
Breadth deteriorated sharply: the new-high ratio fell to zero, the new-low ratio reached 10.97 percent (17 names), and the share above the 200-day average dropped to 52.26 percent.
Volatility and crypto repriced together: VIX rose to 17.1 from 15.84, bitcoin fell to 75901 and ether to 2403.49.
Sector leadership kept narrowing: only 7 of 22 sectors and themes advanced, with networking +1.39 percent at the top and fintech -1.98 percent at the bottom.
watch_next: Tomorrow's US Advance Retail Sales release on 2026-09-16 is the week's key incremental macro input and a direct test of consumer resilience.

The Fed decision and Chair Warsh's press conference (Wednesday, US time) is the dominant event risk and the market is pricing a hike; the calendar layer separately lists the FOMC meeting on 2026-09-28.
Long-end rates and energy prices form a twin constraint: the 10-year yield at 4.96 percent combined with sharply higher crude settlements compresses both valuations and margins.
Watch whether breadth repairs: if the new-high ratio stays at zero while the new-low ratio remains above 10.97 percent, the composite risk score may push toward the 50 threshold.
Watch Costco (COST) earnings on 2026-09-24, the first major consumer read of next week and a lagged confirmation of the retail sales data.

bull_case.title: Bull case: continued core disinflation and stable credit spreads pull the composite risk score back from 47.98
points: If core CPI at 2.44616 percent keeps falling and high-yield spreads hold below 2.71 percent, the macro constraint eases progressively.
A crypto stabilization combined with a volatility retreat (VIX back below 15.84) would repair cross-asset confirmation and release risk budget.

base_case.title: Base case: the macro constraint holds and the composite risk score oscillates between 45 and 50
points: The 10-year yield stays near 4.96 percent and the real rate at 2.6 percent lacks a downside trigger, leaving the macro dimension near 63.8.
Sector divergence persists as capital rotates among a handful of hardware leaders, with gains and losses mixed across the 22 sectors and themes.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a breadth breakdown combined with energy and rate shocks pushes the composite risk score above 50
points: If the new-high ratio stays at zero while the new-low ratio breaks above 10.97 percent and high-yield spreads exceed 2.71 percent, equity selling accelerates markedly.
A delivered hike with the 10-year yield breaking above 4.96 percent would push the real rate at 2.6 percent against the top of its 100th-percentile range, deepening the valuation compression.
